entity.title: End-to-end coverage
entity.description: What the e2e suite must cover, and when it must pass.

rules.body: Every action.yml input and every APPROVE rule MUST have an e2e scenario or a stated exemption.
An e2e scenario that expects no approval MUST also assert the decision and reason the action logged.
A pull request into main MUST NOT merge unless the e2e suite passed on its head.
A new approval path MUST pass its e2e scenarios in the sandbox before any production repository enables it.
